# t17.1 — Fix review bugs: addresses.jsp EL + admin JSP CSRF tokens

## Summary
Fixed 2 view-layer issues from architect review (t17-F1) and security audit (t18-F-01). 7 JSP files modified.

## Fixes Applied

### F1 (BUG): addresses.jsp EL property — `${address.default}` → `${address.isDefault}`
- **File**: `WEB-INF/jsp/account/addresses.jsp` lines 43-44
- **Root cause**: `default` is a reserved keyword in EL; boolean getter `isDefault()` maps to `${address.isDefault}`
- **Impact**: Resolves HTTP 500 on `/account/addresses`

### F-01 (MEDIUM): Admin JSP CSRF token expression — `${_csrfToken}` → `${_csrf.token}`
- **Files** (6): `admin/orders/list.jsp`, `admin/orders/detail.jsp`, `admin/coupons/edit.jsp`, `admin/shipping/edit.jsp`, `admin/products/list.jsp`, `admin/products/edit.jsp`
- **Root cause**: Admin JSPs used `${_csrfToken}` (interceptor model attribute) instead of `${_csrf.token}` (Spring Security request attribute). The interceptor path is fragile on redirects.
- **Pattern**: `name="_csrfToken"` kept (configured parameter name); only value expression changed
- **Impact**: Prevents potential 403 CSRF errors when interceptor `postHandle()` doesn't fire

## Verification
- Source files confirmed clean: zero `${address.default}` and zero `value="${_csrfToken}"` in `monolith-new/src/`
- Build not runnable in current environment (offline Maven, missing parent POM) — JSPs are runtime-compiled, no compile-time validation possible
- Runtime verification deferred to t19 (tester)
